questions.text: Should the opening invocation be visualized only as typography cards, or should we include illustrative establishing shots of Chandrabhaga river bank and Lord Pandurang?
Is the narrator (Sant Dasganu Maharaj) ever shown on screen in this chapter, or is his voice purely off-screen narration?
What is the approved visual style for the typography cards (font, color, background) beyond 'flat-colour style'?
What is the exact visual appearance of Bankatlal (age, facial features, clothing details) for consistent character design?
Should Maharaj's vision be shown as a translucent overlay on Bankatlal's POV shots, or as a separate cutaway?
No suitable Marathi voice for elderly Ramajipant Deshmukh in library; should we use a non-Marathi voice (e.g., George) or wait for a Marathi elder voice?
Is the 'four days passed' montage (S2-10) to be shown as a single slow push on a static image, or a series of dissolving images? (Preset 03 only supports single image)
Should the sound of Maharaj's chant 'Gan Gan Ganat Bote' be audible in the background during Bankatlal's longing shots, or only implied?
What is the exact visual appearance of Govindbuwa Taklikar (age, clothing, instruments) beyond the textual description?
Should Pitambar be shown with any specific tailor tools besides measuring tape (e.g., scissors, cloth)?
Is the Neem tree at the back of the temple a specific landmark to be consistently depicted across shots?
Does the Malin appear on screen in this scene, or is her house only referenced? If she appears, what is her look?
The similes in Ovi 29 (chataka, peacock, chakora) are narrator's poetic imagery. Should they be visualized metaphorically or left as narration only?
What is the exact state of the zunka-bhakri when offered? Bowl material, bhakri thickness, portion size?
Where exactly does the initial eating and instruction take place? Malin's house, Shiva temple, or Bankatlal's house?
What is the visual appearance of Shri Gajanan Maharaj (clothing, hair, accessories) as per canonical description?
What is the visual appearance of Pitambar Shimpi (age, clothing, distinguishing features)?
Does the miracle show the hollow forming dynamically, or only the result (tumba submerged)?
Is Bankatlal present during this scene, or only Pitambar and Maharaj?
What time of day is it? The lighting direction affects shadows and mood.
What is the exact size and shape of the tumba? Is it a typical bottle gourd shape?
Exact visual design of Vyaghrambari and Dudandi coins (size, inscriptions, wear) not described in source; need reference images or artistic decision.
Line S5-L8 says 'you both' - confirms Bankatlal and Pitambar Shimpi are the two devotees; verify Pitambar's presence in this scene.
Precise spatial relationship between neem tree, temple steps, and stone pavement (faras) for shot composition.
Malin's bhakri is referenced in dialogue but not shown; decide if any visual reference needed.
What is the exact appearance of the mandali (number, age range, clothing details)?
Does Govindbuwa hold the Bhagavatam book throughout, or place it aside after the verse?
Is the neem tree the only tree in the courtyard? Are there other features like a bell, Nandi statue, etc.?
Does Maharaj have any specific gesture when chanting the second half (e.g., hand movement, mudra)?
When Govindbuwa proclaims to the crowd (L16-L19), is he on the dias or at ground level?
The script mentions 'गर्जून' (roared/loudly) for L16; should we show a wide shot of crowd reaction?
The 'stone pavement (Faras)' is mentioned in research; should it be visibly textured in the establishing shot?
What is the exact architectural layout of Manik Chowk at sunset (shop positions, central feature)?
Should the cowherd be visually distinct or remain a generic background figure?
How many shopkeepers are visible lighting lamps, and what are their specific actions?
What is Bhavaniram's exact attire and physical details (e.g., beard length, shawl color)?
How should the metaphorical 'sun of wisdom' be visually suggested in the Manik Chowk establishing shot?
What is the exact visual appearance of Ichharam Shetji (age, clothing, distinguishing features like rudraksha, vibhuti)?
How should the transformation of Bankatlal's house into Dwarka be depicted visually (architectural details, signage, symbolic elements)?
What specific naivedya items are offered beyond 'various' for accurate depiction (e.g., specific sweets, fruits)?
Is there a specific color palette or line weight for the approved flat-colour style beyond the general description?
Should the narrator's voice be heard over all shots, or only for the narration lines (S9-L1 to S9-L9)?

The forceful vomiting leela (ovi 122) matches no preset; confirm NEED_NEW missing_image and whether a stylized non-graphic depiction is acceptable.

Should the visual of Maharaj as Vitthal standing on a brick (Ovi 138) be a direct depiction or a symbolic representation?

For the chilim shot (Ovi 146), should we show Maharaj's face or only hands?
